caseNameFull: Fisher v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Mr. Benjamin E. Jaffe for petitioners., Solicitor General Biddle, Assistant Attorney General Clark, and Messrs. Arnold Raum and Maurice J. Mahoney for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Murphy took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
